showcase.zh: 证明板上点的框，就是证明项里没写出来的那部分：要证的那句里，哪几处是从等式一边换过来的，叫动机；核从要证的那句和后一个框的类型里把它读出来
showcase.en: the boxes ticked on the proof board are the part a term does not write out: which places of the sentence to prove came from one side of the equation, the motive; the kernel reads it off the sentence to prove and the type of the second box

t.zh: 用等式只有一条路：h ▸ p（Lean 里是 Eq.rec）。h 证 a = b，p 证关于 a 的一句话，h ▸ p 证关于 b 的那一句。换掉哪几处，由说明。
t.en: There is one way to use an equation: h ▸ p (Eq.rec in Lean). If h proves a = b and p proves a sentence about a, h ▸ p proves the same sentence about b. Which places are replaced is given by the .

t.zh: 它就是证明板上的<part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref>：先接一个，看它写出的证明项，再到证明项板上自己写。
t.en: It is <part-ref to="part:rewrite"></part-ref> on the proof board: wire one first and see the term it writes, then write it yourself on the term board.

brief.zh: 已知 p：「晨星 = 昏星」、q：「晨星很亮」，证出「昏星很亮」，再看它的证明项。
brief.en: Given p: “the Morning Star = the Evening Star” and q: “the Morning Star is bright”, prove “the Evening Star is bright”, then look at its term.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: 「□ ▸ □」：前一个框放等式，后一个框放关于晨星的那句。
hint.en: “□ ▸ □”: the equation in the first box, the sentence about the Morning Star in the second.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: 这回 q 说的是昏星，要证的是晨星：核两个方向都会试。
hint.en: This time q is about the Evening Star and the goal about the Morning Star: the kernel tries both ways.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: 先由 q 换出「昏星很亮」，再交给 r。
hint.en: First turn q into “the Evening Star is bright”, then give it to r.
